text: MoonBase Staff Handbook MoonBase is a shared lunar research station. Everyone must follow posted safety signs and report hazards to mission control. If an oxygen alarm sounds, move to the nearest marked safe zone and notify the on-duty engineer.

If an oxygen alarm sounds, move to the nearest marked safe zone and notify the on-duty engineer. Do not enter an airlock unless trained and authorized. Handbook quick reference Situation Everyone should Oxygen alarm Go to safe zone; alert engineer Airlock use Only trained, authorized crew

Oxygen Alarm Runbook For trained engineering crew. At an oxygen partial pressure below 19.5 kPa, acknowledge the alarm at the habitat console, check the redundant sensor, notify mission control, and inspect the life-support loop from the safe side of the inner hatch. Do not cycle the airlock during an active pressure fault.

Do not cycle the airlock during an active pressure fault. If pressure continues to fall, isolate the affected habitat section and follow mission control instructions. Airlock A diagram: habitat is on the left; the inner hatch separates it from the airlock on the right.
